coverage: Played one full 40-turn game as Testland in a real browser at 1280x720 (about 55 End Turns with three short extra games): civilians moved and ordered (prospect, develop levels 1-3, rail, depot, port, fort), capital orders (production, expansion and cancel, freight car and cancel, training to trained and expert and cancel, recruit), transport sliders, Warehouse, Market (sell, bid, consulate), Deal Book, Diplomacy consulate, news, score, Council and game-over screens, cursors for all 7 civilian types, cancel and undo, refusal texts, running out of money (a regiment was disbanded), viewports 1024x768 to 1920x1080. Cash, warehouse, production, sales, bids, upkeep, score parts and news agreed on every turn I checked (cash invariant checked on 20 turns). A headless fuzz (12 seeds x 40 turns, 914 accepted random capital orders) found no negative or NaN value and exact undo; the engine economy is sound, the problems are in the UI path and in missing features. No console error or warning in the whole session.
not_covered: Food starvation in the app (food stock never ran low because everything is shipped, see ECONOMY-01; the engine is covered by tests and matches rules 05), sick workers display, mountains/swamp/oil/driller work, river ports, fish, second depot networks and branching rail beyond one line, Armoury/army/war, diplomacy beyond a consulate, Valdoria AI behaviour (only noted that it scored 1291 against my 686), keyboard accessibility, touch, a Council win.

findings.title: Transport sliders do not limit anything: spare capacity is filled automatically, so "Allocated 0 / Remaining 15" still ships everything
repro: New game as Testland, turn 1. Open "Transportation of Commodities". Move Grain, Fruit and Cotton all to 0 (dialog reads Allocated 0, Remaining 15).
Press Advance Turn. Open the Warehouse and compare with the turn before.
Later (depot at 5-8 finished, 20 units collected for capacity 15): leave the sliders at 0 and end the turn again.
findings.expected: Only what the sliders allocate is shipped (rules 04: "a tile's output above what you allocate is wasted"; the popup shows Allocated and Remaining). With all sliders at 0 nothing should arrive.
findings.actual: Everything still arrived. Turn 4 of my game, all sliders 0: grain +5 shipped (net +1 after 4 eaten), fruit +4 shipped (net +2 after 2 eaten), cotton +2 shipped, the same as with the sliders set. Turn 7 (20 units collected, capacity 15, sliders 0): cotton 0 shipped, so the textile mill ran on 1 fabric until I set Cotton 2 by hand. The unallocated capacity is handed out in tile-scan order, not by player choice, and the popup never says so.
findings.evidence: From my play log: "T4 (alloc all zero) ... DIFF {grain:+1, livestock:-1, fruit:+2, cotton:-2, coal:-2, ironOre:-2...}" with workers eating grain 4, fruit 2, livestock 1; "T7 ... DIFF {grain:+5, livestock:+1, fruit:+2, cotton:-4 ...}" (cotton -4 = 4 used, 0 shipped). Transport dialog at that time: "Capacity 15 / Allocated 0 / Remaining 15 / Grain 0 / 9, Livestock 0 / 2, Fruit 0 / 7, Cotton 0 / 2". findings.title: An engineer cannot lay the last rail section into the capital by clicking it: the click silently becomes a plain move and the turn is lost
repro: New game. Turn 1: pick the engineer from the capital stack, click tile 4-9 (not next to the capital, so it is a plain move, $0).
Turn 2: click the engineer's own tile, choose Build Depot ($2,000). End turns until the news says "Depot finished at 4-9" (turn 4). The map shows "Depot: not connected".
Turn 5: select the engineer, click 3-9: rail section 4-9 to 3-9 is built ($100). End turn.
Turn 6: select the engineer on 3-9 and click the capital 2-9 (the tile next to it). Check cash, news and the depot after End Turn.
findings.expected: A rail section 3-9 to capital is ordered ($100), "Rail finished" appears and the depot turns "connected" (FR-137: a section may end on a rail node such as the capital; the engine accepts it).
findings.actual: The engineer just walks onto the capital, cash is unchanged, no refusal text, no news line, and the depot stays "Depot: not connected". Only after standing ON the capital and clicking 3-9 (turn 7, $100) did "Rail finished at 3-9" appear and the depot become "connected". A first-time player loses a turn without being told why.
findings.evidence: Play log: "T6 engineer 3-9 -> capital Cash: $7,400 | refusal: -" then the turn 6 news has only "Army upkeep: $100." and the depot list [["4-9","Depot: not connected"]]; the map has a single Testland rail segment (3-9 to 4-9). findings.title: Goods shipped this turn arrive after production, so they are used one turn later; nothing in the transport popup or capital says so
repro: Ship 2 cotton while cotton stock is 2 and the textile order is 2 fabric.
findings.expected: A note "arrives at End Turn, usable next turn" (rules 01 puts transport arrival last).
findings.actual: Production used only the old stock: turn 9 "Produced 1 Fabric" although 4 cotton were in reach (2 in stock + 2 shipped). The capital card says "Order 2: only 1 can be made (short of inputs)", which is correct, but the transport popup does not say the shipment is not counted yet.
findings.evidence: Play log turn 9: DIFF cotton 0, "Produced 1 Fabric."
